input.title: Aventon Abound SR
input.descriptionHtml:
All-new Aventon Abound SR compact cargo ebike. 750W motor, 4G/GPS smart security, Sensor Switch, suspension fork and seatpost, 440 lb payload. Cobalt, Haze, or Stealth at Quest Watersports. $1,899.

**Please note - This bike is available by special order only and is not regularly stocked. Please call us at (815) 433-2200 for more info or to place an order**

Aventon Abound SR Ebike Powerful Cargo Electric Bike for Commuting and Hauling

The Aventon Abound SR Ebike is a versatile and reliable electric cargo bike designed to handle daily commutes, grocery runs, and larger loads. Equipped with a 750W rear hub motor, the Abound SR offers 80Nm of torque, allowing it to tackle hills with ease and reach speeds of up to 20 mph. Whether you're carrying heavy cargo or riding for pleasure, this ebike provides a smooth and efficient ride.

With a 708Wh battery featuring premium LG 21700 cells, the Abound SR provides a long-range capability of up to 60 miles on a single charge. Built with a durable aluminum gravity-cast frame, this ebike can carry a maximum payload of 440 lbs, making it ideal for transporting groceries, school bags, or larger loads.

The Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetrain and Tektro hydraulic disc brakes offer superior performance, while the 50mm suspension seatpost enhances comfort, even on bumpy roads. The rear rack can carry up to 143 lbs, making the Abound SR a perfect companion for work, school, or weekend adventures.

**E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee** 


Key Features:

  • 750W rear hub motor with 80Nm torque for powerful hill climbing
  • 708Wh battery with up to 60 miles of range
  • Durable aluminum frame with a maximum payload of 440 lbs
  • Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetrain for smooth gear shifting
  • Tektro hydraulic disc brakes for reliable stopping power
  • 50mm suspension seatpost for added comfort on rough terrain
  • Rear rack with a 143 lbs capacity, perfect for carrying gear or cargo
  • Integrated front and rear lights with turn signal functionality
  • 4G GPS tracking and smart lock kickstand for enhanced security

Aventon Abound SR Ebike Specifications

Recommended Rider Height 4'11" 6'3"
